propositions: _same_level_neighbors must confine traversal to the queried level via both a CURRENT-side inline guard and a TARGET-side _is_at_level check; deleting either allows a direct cross-level edge to flip the cycle detection verdict from False to True.

A multi-hop chain (epic → task → epic) must not allow a lower-level node to reconnect two same-level nodes in cycle detection, even though the inline current-side guard alone already prevents traversal.

When reduce returns None and a non-terminal-status tombstone is present, _load_states_with_tombstones must construct a status-only stub so the tombstoned blocker's status is loaded; deleting this branch causes newly unblocked detection to fail.
A present tombstone's status must override the reduced status; a blocker with open reduced status but deleted tombstone status must count as closed and unblock the target.
A malformed tombstone must degrade to 'deleted' status rather than to missing; _read_tombstone_status exception handling must return 'deleted' not None so closed detection treats it as closed.
